Defective vitamin D metabolism or response causes hypocalcemia and impaired bone mineralization.
CNGA1-associated retinal degeneration with rod-cone dysfunction and progressive visual loss.
B-cell lymphoplasmacytic neoplasm/lymphoma; intestinal infiltration typifies alpha disease, the commonest subtype, supporting >30% overall.
Entrapment neuropathy of abdominal cutaneous nerves; abdominal pain does not indicate gastrointestinal organ damage.
Defined by neonatal seizures, encephalopathy and persistent neurodevelopmental impairment.
Neurological movement disorder affecting the ipsilateral arm and leg; muscle contractions alone do not establish muscle damage.
Defining eyelid/ocular motility abnormalities and syndactyly; cranial nerve abnormalities occur in 80-99%. Intellectual disability is occasional.
Chronic inflammatory anterior uveitis with iris atrophy and keratic precipitates; no common extraocular damage.
HPV-associated verrucous tumor of anogenital skin; anal mucosal origin is site-specific rather than universal across the concept.
Clonal bone marrow malignancy with ineffective hematopoiesis and cytopenias; leukemia/myeloid neoplasia does not itself imply an immune axis.
Antibody immunodeficiency; recurrent pneumonia reflects susceptibility to separate infections, without documented chronic pulmonary damage.
Axonal peripheral neuropathy; structural foot deformity occurs in 10/12 patients and distal muscle weakness in 12/12.
Twisting of bowel produces intestinal obstruction; associated bowel ischemia remains within the gastrointestinal axis.
Fibroblastic sarcoma arising in deep soft connective tissues; collagen rosettes describe tumor histology.
Congenital dysplasia of the anal sphincter; the anus and its sphincter apparatus belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Developmental disorder with defining sleep apnea; most have structural malformations including contractures, scoliosis or talipes. Cleft frequency is unspecified.
Glossopharyngeal nerve irritation/compression causes neuralgia; referred ear and tongue pain do not establish damage to those organs.
Defining digital and joint abnormalities; dental malocclusion/open bite occurs in 30-79%. Hearing loss and intellectual disability occur in fewer than 30%.
Defined as impaired central cognitive processing of sensory information, including neglect and agnosia; sensory organ damage is not implied.
Recurrent nocturnal urinary incontinence is a bladder/urinary continence disorder; no additional organ damage is established.
HPV infection causes recurrent papillomas occupying the laryngeal airway.
Acute leukemia of blood and marrow with mixed T-cell and myeloid differentiation; mixed lineage does not make it lymphoma.
Persistent neuralgia from nerve injury following infection; the antecedent infection does not establish ongoing infection or immune-mediated disease.
